question: Does the centered rational lift rank-one yield from the training panel persist on deterministic unseen prime-order fields?
training: eight fields 313,421,431,547,571,593,617,677; u=1..5 inspected before this holdout
field_selection: the first eight prime p>677 for which #E(F_p) is prime, E:y^2=x^3-x-2; scan p in increasing order using exact Legendre-symbol point count and trial-division primality
candidate_reduced_points: uG for u=1,2,3,4,5; G=(2,2) on each prime-order field
lift: center each affine x,y in [-p/2,p/2]; B=y^2-x^3+x; E/Q:y^2=x^3-x+B; P=(x,y)
rank_test: checked Sage E.rank(proof=True) and torsion_subgroup().order(), retaining errors and timeouts
promotion: only proved rank-one, trivial-torsion rows with point independently checked as a signed Mordell-Weil generator
claim_boundary: holdout rank-screen event rate and finite-panel admission, not a wall-time or same-target speed comparison
